1453.name: Game Wizard for Android
1453.content:
![](/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/android-splash-r.png)

Game Wizard for Android is a multi-platform gaming machine that provides endless entertainment options. Users can simply connect to their Google account and start downloading their favourite games and apps from Google's Play store onto the machine. For more choice, plug in PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox 360, Xbox One, PC or arcade JAMMA boards (no need for additional adapters). Play via touchscreen, arcade joystick and pushbuttons or console hand controller.

## See it in Action

[videogallery id="Game Wizard for Android"]

The Game Wizard for Android supports a number of games - from classic arcade and pinball machine titles to games for external consoles and PC. Custom switches on the front of the machine allow users to easily change between Android and console mode, touchscreen and joystick mode.



## How the Game Wizard for Android Works

### Play via Touch, Joystick or Hand Controller

![](/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/controller-300x222.jpg)

Games can be played on the Game Wizard for Android using the touchscreen HD LCD monitor, two-player arcade panel with authentic Japanese made joysticks and pushbuttons, or by connecting an external console controller using the USB ports built into the machine.


### Unlimited Gaming

![](/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/connect-300x222.jpg)

Players can download unlimited games via the Google Play store (subject to Google's terms and conditions). Game Wizard for Android also supports PlayStation, Xbox, PC and other late model consoles. For further gaming options connect to Steam, Xbox Live, PlayStation Network and Origin using personal accounts. No extra modifications or wiring necessary.


### Jukebox Sound Including Subwoofer

![](/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/subwoofer-300x222.jpg)

Applications for music and video streaming can also be downloaded from the Google Play store and used on the Game Wizard for Android. This means the machine can double as a video jukebox, further enhanced by the jukebox quality speakers and subwoofer built into the cabinet.


### Supports All Current Consoles

![](/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/consoles-300x222.jpg)

Game Wizard for Android is compatible with Xbox 360, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PC and other late model consoles. Users can also plug in and play games with PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Xbox 360 controllers. Continuous firmware updates means the machine will be compatible with latest consoles.
